If you get stuck with this config, please open an issue or get in touch via the discord.
Here are some of the variables you may want to change:
PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT - You can increase this if Global Placement fails with error GPL-0302.
Users have reported that values up to 80 worked well for them.
CLOCK_PERIOD - Increase this in case you are getting setup time violations.
The value is in nanoseconds, so 20ns == 50MHz.
Hold slack margin - Increase them in case you are getting hold violations.
RUN_LINTER, LINTER_INCLUDE_PDK_MODELS - Disabling the linter is not recommended!
If you need a custom clock configuration, read the following documentation first:
https://tinytapeout.com/faq/#how-can-i-map-an-additional-external-clock-to-one-of-the-gpios
================= SRAM macro integration (DECISIONS D-025, branch sram-macro) =================
Recipe adapted, with attribution, from thomasgilbert481/tt_um_loom (Apache-2.0): see
macro/RM_IHPSG13_1P_256x16_c2_bm_bist/README.md and the header of src/pdn_cfg.tcl.
MACROS: the LibreLane way of bringing in a hard macro. The instance key is the FLATTENED
path: tt_um_ahan17x_keyer -> u_imem (keyer_imem) -> u_sram. Orientation FS (mirrored about X)
puts the macro's 108 Metal2 signal pins (LEF y 0..0.26) on its top edge, facing the rows
above; location [12, 40] is the lower-left corner in die coordinates (6x4 block: DIEAREA
power columns with the stripe grid below (x = 12 + 67.44 k would too). The lib keys name
the process corner because the cmos5l STA corners are all nom_*.
PDN_MACRO_CONNECTIONS: both macro supplies (VDD! periphery, VDDARRAY! bit cells) to VPWR, VSS! to VGND.
PDN_CFG: LibreLane's default PDN script with the macro grid replaced (full-height Metal4 stripes
through the macro's same-net power columns, verified at run time). See src/pdn_cfg.tcl.
Magic reads the full macro GDS (cmos5l streams out with klayout; harmless, as the reference needs).
Magic's cmos5l tech lacks the SRAM DRC exceptions the KLayout sign-off deck applies; every Magic
DRC error of the sibling's run was inside the macro, and Magic DRC is not part of the cmos5l precheck.
One checked case: the POWER stripes cross the Metal4 OBS at the macro's VDD!/VDDARRAY! split and
Magic, extracting the macro from its LEF, reports them as illegal overlaps. The GDS has no Metal4
there; LVS and the precheck's KLayout DRC check the real metal.
Blackbox the macro during SPICE extraction for LVS: the IHP macros are not LVS clean.
Slew repair margin (DECISIONS D-041). The flow repairs slew once, after global placement, at the
typical corner, to (100 - this)% of the library limit; the default 20 left nets that are over the
limit at the slow corner, where the cells are 1.7 to 1.8 times slower (13 pins on two nets in run
37286790227). 50 holds a net to 1.25 ns at the typical corner, about 2.2 ns at the slow one (limit 2.507).
Configuration docs: https://librelane.readthedocs.io/en/latest/reference/configuration.html
